metadata.notes: ClientPlatform is architecturally unique within the portal: its two pages draw from fundamentally different upstream pipelines. ModelPortfolios is Yang/SmartX-driven (AUM data from SmartX EC2, benchmarks and peers from Yang). AdvisorIntelligence is BD-driven (partner AUA and NNA data from Black Diamond via BD pipeline). The GEO/ADV cohort toggle is a cross-panel interaction pattern specific to this pod.

page.name: ModelPortfolios
page.summary: Real-time AUA tracking and portfolio performance analysis for the five Opal model portfolios (Ultra Short-Term, Short-Term, Intermediate, Long-Term Conservative, Long-Term Aggressive). Organizes data across three tabs: Growth (donut chart, quarterly metrics, account distribution bell curve), Performance (benchmark heatmap and return/volatility scatter), and Peers (Morningstar quartile peer comparison). Data sourced exclusively from Yang pipeline (SmartX time series via portal-proxy and yang-model-portfolio-benchmarks Lambda).

tabs.tab: Default tab. Portfolio Analytics panel: donut chart (AUA by model, interactive legend), AUMGrowthMetrics (quarterly change cards), AccountDistributionChart (bell curve by model). Non-Model AUA roll-forward note. State: selectedDonutIndex, periodView (monthly/quarterly), trendMetricType (value/count).

Lazy-loads model-portfolio-benchmarks and etf-benchmark-returns queries when first activated. Displays BenchmarkHeatmap and ReturnVolatilityScatter. Toggles: benchmarkReturnType (gross/net), benchmarkType (index/etf).

Lazy-loads peer-performance query when first activated. Renders PeersTab component: quartile chart with model and benchmark position arrows per Morningstar peer universe. Model selector (UST/ST/INT/LTC/LTA, default LTC). Applies annualizeSinceInceptionReturn transformation before display.

page.summary: Partner AUA analytics and reporting dashboard for advisor-facing intelligence on partner firm data sourced from the Black Diamond Wealth Platform via the BD pipeline. Page v5. Features a permanent PartnerAnalytics header panel (above all tabs) with AUA/NNA/GEO/ADV view toggle, plus three tabs: Distribution (firm cohort analysis — snapshot and continuous views), Advisors (rolling flows and leaderboard), and Books (per-advisor book drilldown and client detail). Multi-tenant: partner firm selection controls all tab data (defaults to '49financial').

tabs.tab: Dual-mode: (1) Snapshot — ApexCharts donut with segment legend, time machine strip for quarterly comparison, bell curve histogram with percentile lines (P10/P25/Median/P75/P90), cohort toggle (GEO/ADV), metric toggle (AUA/NNA/CLA), drill-down into states->cities and architects->clients. (2) Continuous — stacked area chart with hero metrics and legend, window selector (3M/6M/1Y/2Y/3Y/Max), asset toggle. Data: getCumulativeChart() for continuous; PartnerAnalyticsResponse (page-level getPartnerAnalytics()) passed as prop for snapshot donut + distribution stats. UI state: viewStyle ('snapshot'|'continuous'), cohort ('geo'|'adv'), metric ('aua'|'nna'|'cla'), timePeriod, drilldown state, window.

Architects-only view. Top 3 highlights panel with period toggle (QTD/YTD — MTD removed, leaderboard JSON uses uppercase keys MTD/QTD/YTD since bd-v2.18.4). Leaderboard with AUA/NNA/Growth metric toggle and diverging horizontal bar chart for NNA mode showing inflows/outflows per advisor. Rolling Flows stacked bar (per-period inflows/outflows/net NNA). NNA colors: inflow #2196F3, outflow #EF4444 — matches PartnerAnalytics NNA_COLORS. Data: getArchitectLeaderboard(), getAdvisorRollingFlows(). Window lookup: periodToWindowKey() returns uppercase 'QTD'/'YTD' to match JSON keys.

Canonical 4-level drill hierarchy: N1 (Firm) -> L2 (Advisor Book) -> L3 (Relationship) -> L4 (Account). Each level renders CanonicalBookView = ConsolidatedOverviewPanel (metric cards + asset mix donut + top holdings + quarterly bar) + TaxCostBasisPanel. Level-specific data: N1: getFirmMixViews (quarterly bar), firm/all/composition (mix donut + holdings), getClientsTab (headline). L2: getAdvisorBook (summary), getAdvisorTimeseries + getAdvisorMixTimeseries (quarterly bar via deriveQuarterlyFromTimeseries), advisor/all/composition (fallback synthesis from asset_allocation). L3: getBooksClientDetail, getBooksRelationshipComposition, getBooksRelationshipTimeseries + getMixTimeseries (quarterly bar). L4: getBooksAccountComposition, account data from clientDetailData.accounts. Uses useAuth for isFirmAdmin gate (N1 only shown to internal/dev users).

lifecycle_and_state.state_management: Main page uses React Query (TanStack Query) for partner-analytics fetch. Tabs use mix of React Query (AdvisorsTab) and useEffect+useState (ClientsTab, AssetIntelligenceTab). All data from S3 static files via portal-proxy (bd-portal-publisher generated artifacts).
lifecycle_and_state.data_flow: 1. Page mounts -> partner-analytics query fires (loads donut/distribution/metrics for all 4 views + time machine periods). 2. PartnerAnalytics component renders header with donut, bell curve, time machine strip. 3. Tab content loads tab-specific data on mount (cumulative chart, leaderboard, rolling flows, clients tab, etc.). 4. Drill-down: click donut segment -> nested data (cities within state, clients within architect). 5. Time machine: click quarterly strip -> view historical snapshot for that period.
lifecycle_and_state.type_guards: types.ts defines: hasTimeMachine, hasCities, hasClients, hasFlows — used to narrow PartnerAnalyticsResponse.views sub-shapes at runtime.

geo_adv_cohort_pattern.description: GEO/ADV is a cross-panel cohort toggle present in both the PartnerAnalytics header panel and the DistributionTab. Toggling it switches the segmentation dimension across: (1) PartnerAnalytics donut chart segments (geographic regions vs architect names), (2) DistributionTab donut segmentation and bell curve grouping, (3) DistributionTab continuous chart series. This is the primary cross-panel interaction pattern the DE must coordinate for any work touching Distribution or PartnerAnalytics. GEO uses city/region geographic groupings. ADV uses architect (financial advisor) groupings. Type aliases: CohortOption ('geo' | 'adv') in DistributionTab; PartnerAnalyticsViewMode in types.ts covers aua/nna/geo/adv.

known_issues.issue: Leaderboard sort instability on NNA ties — root cause (a) frontend. JS .sort() had no secondary key; equal numeric values reordered non-deterministically when window prop changed (new data array reference). Fixed: added name.localeCompare() as stable tiebreaker when primary cmp === 0 and sortField !== 'name'. Committed 2026-03-04.

upstream_infrastructure.description: ModelPortfolios draws its benchmark and peer data from the Yang pipeline via opal-portal-data-proxy Lambda (portal-proxy). AUM time series data originates from SmartX EC2 (persistent instance) and is stored in DynamoDB, then served through portal-proxy. Model portfolio benchmark returns and ETF comparisons are generated by yang-model-portfolio-benchmarks Lambda and served through portal-proxy /v1/benchmarks/returns and /v1/benchmarks/etf. Peer performance data (/v1/peers/performance) is generated by yang-generate-peer-performance Lambda. This dependency means ModelPortfolios data freshness is gated on Yang pipeline runs.

lambdas.lambda: opal-portal-data-proxy (API proxy for all portal-proxy.ts calls)

ec2_services.service: smartx-exporter (AUM time series source — persistent EC2)

upstream_infrastructure.description: AdvisorIntelligence draws all partner AUA/NNA data from the BD (Black Diamond) pipeline. bd-portal-publisher generates aggregate partner analytics (partner_analytics/header_metrics.json, timeseries_chart.json, advisor_rolling_flows.json). bd-portal-advisor-publisher generates per-advisor book files (advisors/{advisorId}/book.json). bd-client-detail generates per-client detail files (clients/{clientKey}.json). opal-partners-data Lambda handles real-time scoped API requests (timeseries/{dimension}, snapshots/{dimension}, filters). All static JSON artifacts are served via CloudFront → S3 (opal-data-portal-v2 bucket) with firm-level routing handled by shared-advisor-router. Data freshness is gated on daily BD pipeline runs.
